question: In India, the Fiscal Health Index 2025 is based on a comprehensive set of indicators that are grouped into ______ broad categories.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Fiscal Health Index 2025** in India is based on a comprehensive set of indicators grouped into **five broad categories**.
 
• The categories include factors such as **revenue generation, expenditure management, debt sustainability, economic growth, and fiscal prudence.**
 
• It aims to assess the financial health of states and the central government using a multidimensional approach to measure their fiscal performance.
 
• The **five categories** allow policymakers to identify areas of concern and strengths, facilitating better resource allocation and fiscal planning.
 
• The grouping into five categories ensures that the index captures a holistic view of fiscal health rather than focusing on a single dimension, such as revenue
